inventive_nucleus: A curved interface design reduces the contact area between dissimilar metals, minimizing galvanic corrosion.

claim_versions.claim: A curved interface design, wherein the curvature is optimized to reduce the contact area between dissimilar metals, minimizes galvanic corrosion under conditions of high humidity and temperature fluctuations.

redesign.new_claim: A curved interface design, wherein the curvature is optimized to reduce the contact area between dissimilar metals, minimizes galvanic corrosion under conditions of high humidity and temperature fluctuations.
redesign.change: Added an operating condition (high humidity and temperature fluctuations) and specified the optimization of the curvature.
redesign.reason: This revised claim should survive the prior-art attack because it adds a specific operating condition that is not explicitly taught in the prior art, and the optimization of the curvature is a distinguishing feature that is not a straightforward modification of the prior art.

all_mappings.evidence_note: The reference explicitly teaches the curved interface design (element A) to reduce galvanic corrosion.
The reference explicitly teaches the biocompatible material (element B) that interacts with surrounding tissue.
The reference explicitly teaches both the curved interface design (element A) and the biocompatible material (element B) to minimize galvanic corrosion.
The reference explicitly teaches the curved interface design (element A) to reduce contact area between dissimilar metals.

novelty_attack.reasoning: This reference explicitly teaches both the curved interface design and the biocompatible material to minimize galvanic corrosion, satisfying the claim.

obviousness_attack.motivation: Reducing galvanic corrosion by minimizing contact area between dissimilar metals is a well-known technique, and combining a curved interface design with this technique is a straightforward modification.
obviousness_attack.reason_to_modify: The references provide a clear motivation to combine the curved interface design with the technique of minimizing contact area between dissimilar metals.
obviousness_attack.expectation_of_success: A skilled person would expect the combination to be successful in reducing galvanic corrosion.

design_around.easiest_workaround: Using a flat interface design or a different material that does not interact with surrounding tissue
